The '''DF.9/B''' was a fixed-emplacement anti-[[Infantry/Legends|infantry]] weapon produced by [[Golan Arms/Legends|Golan Arms]]. The [[DF.9 laser cannon]] was mounted atop a four-[[Meter/Legends|meter]] tower which was heavily-[[Armor/Legends|armored]]<ref name="ISB" /> and [[proton-shield]]ed.<ref name="DB" /> The DF.9 was mounted on a turret which had a three-hundred and sixty degree field of fire,<ref name="ISB" /> a rapid firing rate,<ref name="DB" /> and a closed canopy. Two crewmembers operated the DF.9/B, both of whom were housed inside the armored tower.<ref name="ISB" /> The optimum effective range of the weapon was three [[Kilometer/Legends|kilometers]], but the DF.9/B's targeting [[Sensor/Legends|sensors]] were capable of striking targets at ranges up to sixteen kilometers away.<ref name="DB" /> The tower was popular with [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Governor/Legends|governors]] for defense against dissenting and unarmed populations.<ref name="ISB" />
